exact_preparation_contract.baseline_other_rows: Copy original cytosol rows, set ER Ca exactly to native 0.2 mM, and solve only the explicitly chosen counterion row. All concentrations must remain finite and strictly positive.
exact_preparation_contract.cache_phase: Prime Dm_channels and Dm_er once from the supplied initial cytosol and initial IP3 owner context without advancing time. First source update recomputes channels normally from actual pre-ER cytosol after the ordinary prefix. Old cached values are not a promise that the prefix leaves cytosol unchanged.
exact_preparation_contract.counterion: Choose explicitly either Cl with z=-1 and its existing moving role, or existing stationary P with z=-1. No new species, buffer or charge sink is introduced.
exact_preparation_contract.general_counterion_equation: For chosen k: c_ER[k,j] = (rho_target_j/F - sum_{i!=k} z_i*c_ER[i,j]) / z_k. For z_k=-1: c_ER[k,j] = sum_{i!=k} z_i*c_ER[i,j] - rho_target_j/F.
exact_preparation_contract.geometry: V_ER=fl(0.1*V_cell), A_ER=fl(1.0*A_cell), cm_ER=the same bound native capacitance. Retain source V_cell for cytosol; do not silently subtract ER volume or reinterpret the total physical cell volume.
exact_preparation_contract.initial_target_roundoff_check: Compare against an independent exact-binary-input charge/capacitance reconstruction and an a priori operation-roundoff bound including counterion rounding. Report absolute C/m3 and V residuals. This bound applies only to preparation, never as a propagated trajectory allowance; existing ER step budgets stay unchanged.
exact_preparation_contract.inventory_boundary: This is a newly declared initial inventory, not an unlogged transfer from the failed initial state. Seal initial per-ion cytosol+ER amounts. No rebalancing, clamping or target-voltage reset occurs after preparation.
exact_preparation_contract.ion_and_cell_axes: Use exact declared ion IDs, valences, cell IDs and ordering from the joined parent; never infer row roles from array position.
exact_preparation_contract.no_hidden_alias_or_draw: Own and freeze full float64 arrays; preserve the joined parent, RNG, clocks, caches and source indices except explicitly declared new initial fields. No random draw, dynamics call, relaxation, parameter search or fitted output is part of preparation.
exact_preparation_contract.rounding: Solve the counterion equation independently at high precision from exact binary64 parent constants, round each prepared concentration once, then derive stored Q and Ver from those stored values in the literal native operation order. Requested target and realized charge/voltage are separate metadata.
exact_preparation_contract.stored_Q: Q_hat = np.sum(zer * F * stored_cc_er, axis=0), with the same float64 operand order as native get_v.
exact_preparation_contract.stored_Ver: Ver_hat = (1/cm_ER) * Q_hat * (V_ER/A_ER), preserving native operation order. Do not force ideal target zero over a representable residual.
exact_preparation_contract.units: Concentrations use native numeric mM = mol/m3. Q is C/m3, V is volts, areas m2, volumes m3, cm F/m2. Total ER charge is Q*er_vol; capacitor charge is cm*er_sa*Ver.
exact_preparation_contract.whole_parent_association: Seal bound source definition, source state digest, declared recipe, complete prepared state, target and realized values. Reconstruct outer State identity using its real factory. Do not manually replace a frozen dataclass field and retain an old identity.

source_order: Attach the fully supplied prepared ER state before the first outer call
Ordinary resets, NaK, membrane/GJ/intra and membrane-buffer refresh
Plasma CaATP followed by original ER channels/SERCA/moving-ion flux/get_v
Network clear, late channels and explicitly empty network chemistry
Deferred ordinary commit/clipping, current and voltage
Carry all owned ER fields, original caches and clocks into the next call

source_policy.ER_channels: Dm_er_base+Dm_channels for allions; non-Ca channel cache remains1e-18, not implicitly zeroed
source_policy.IP3: No owners means Ca-only Hill modulation; any owner but missingIP3 means zeroIP3factor; molecules thenmetabo thengrn precedence
source_policy.initialization: Literal init once: er_vol=.1*cell_vol,er_sa=cell_sa,Ver/Q0,cm_er=p.cm,cc_er deep copy withCa0.2,allion Dm/base/channels1e-18,zer fromvalence; never per-step Ca clamp
source_policy.membrane_buffer: ER bulk transfers never automatically refresh cc_at_mem before late network; preserved stale buffer
source_policy.nonce: Each ER electroflux mutates ER Ver by1e-25; source z receivesseparate nonce; get_v then replacesVer usingallions, including stationary rows
source_policy.order: ordinary refresh -> plasma CaATP storage/cache -> ER channels -> SERCA using oldVer -> directcytosol/ER Ca transfer -> moving-ion ER electroflux and in-place Ver nonce -> all-ion get_v -> late network channels -> ordinary deferredcommit -> current/voltage
source_policy.raw_domain: No ER clipping or source regularization added. Raw unused backwards pole and equilibriumoverflow returnscaptured evenwithfiniteflux. Finitepublication checksseparatefromrawsourcecompletion; no positive-domain/physicalclaim.
source_policy.serca: Literal numericmM quotient cADP*cPi*cER/(cATP*cCyto), exact-zero binary64product ->1e-16, oldVer exponent -deltaG/(RT)-2FV/(RT), positivefluxcyto->ER, unusedbackward retained. Same maintained pools/Km/deltaG as plasma CaATP; no sourcefuel consumption or two-Ca stoichiometry invented.
